name: McDONALD, Susan Eileen

headline.note: Official records establish Queensland ministerial chief-of-staff work from 2012 to 2014 and business management from 2014 to 2019. A retrospective industry profile supports that the concurrent ministerial job and later Super Butcher management were full-time, but employer and first-person material still do not publish the earlier accounting employers, exact transition, complete dates or leave. Political staff, party roles, governance, study and elected office are excluded. The incomplete boundaries and leave record prevent a defensible private full-time total. Early stock-camp and Expo work remain recorded with unknown employers/hours; industry and honorary roles remain excluded.

career_spells.role: Bachelor of Commerce and Bachelor of Economics student
career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies establish both UQ qualifications; the directly linked public professional profile self-reports attendance 1989–1993 at year precision. No exact dates, study workload or separate degree-award dates are inferred.

McDonald's profile identifies her as a qualified accountant. Contemporary 2016–19 professional biographies describe more than 20 years of accountancy and business-management experience, while an alumni profile says she worked as an accountant for various Brisbane businesses before ministerial staffing. Employers, roles, commencement, hours, leave and exact cessation are unpublished. Follow-up 2026-10-02: removed inferred 2012 cessation; sequence before ministerial staffing does not establish a last working date or exclude overlaps. LifeFlight independently confirms unnamed Brisbane businesses.
career_spells.counting_note: A professional qualification and aggregate experience claim do not establish employer-specific full-time intervals.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Queensland Minister for Natural Resources and Mines, Andrew Cripps MP
career_spells.evidence_note: The official federal biography gives a Queensland Government chief-of-staff interval from 2012 to 2014. A 2013 Queensland parliamentary document identifies McDonald as Chief of Staff to Natural Resources and Mines Minister Andrew Cripps. A retrospective November 2019 meat-industry profile says that after her brother's 2013 death she initially managed the six Super Butcher stores on top of her full-time job; in context this supports full-time status for the chief-of-staff job, but not weekly hours or leave. Some later profiles extend the role to 2015; exact appointment/cessation and the Super Butcher overlap require resolution. The 2015 first-person speech confirms sequence but misdates the incoming government to 2011; official 2012 start is preserved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded irrespective of public funding.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives business management from 2014 to 2019. Member and contemporary profiles identify McDonald as Managing Director of family-owned Super Butcher, responsible for five or six stores and roughly 80–100 staff. A retrospective November 2019 meat-industry profile says that after her brother's 2013 death she first managed the six stores on top of her full-time job and then took on Super Butcher in a full-time capacity; full-time status is therefore supported, but the exact transition, payroll/self-employment status, weekly hours, leave and election cessation remain unresolved. ABC says she took over the chain in 2012, while the official interval starts in 2014. Family acquisition is not itself a personal commencement date; 2014 chief-executive reporting and a 2018 primary SSG release corroborate the executive role.
career_spells.counting_note: Substantive full-time private business work is supported, but the conflicting start, uncertain exact transition and missing leave evidence prevent a defensible headline duration.

career_spells.evidence_note: A State Secretary term beginning in 2003 is reported; exact end, pay, hours and accounting overlap remain unknown. Separate LNP trusteeship recorded below.

Self-reported public profile supplies August2016–December2018 board term, consistent with contemporary2016 appointment coverage. The2019 school biography is retained as a conflicting or stale membership description. Listed under Volunteer Experience; remuneration and workload are not independently established.

research_notes: Identify every pre-2012 accounting/business employer, role, date, hours and leave; do not translate an aggregate 20-year experience claim into an exact interval.
Resolve Andrew Cripps chief-of-staff cessation (official 2014 versus profiles extending to 2015), hours, leave and overlap with Super Butcher control reportedly beginning in 2012.

Obtain Super Butcher/MDH appointment, payroll or self-employment status, exact title boundaries, hours, leave and cessation for the Senate campaign; reconcile 2012 takeover with the official 2014 start.
Confirm dates, paid status and hours for National Party state secretary and LNP trustee roles.
Obtain governance appointment/cessation and remuneration evidence for Beef Australia and RNA; governance remains separate from substantive employment.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: searched primary LifeFlight, RNA historical magazines, ABSF reports/releases, school professional biography, Rural Press Club speech and public professional-profile index. Added early stock-camp/Expo work and AMIC/SSG/honorary roles. No accounting employer names or full-time/leave evidence recovered. Arts Queensland board lead unconfirmed and not encoded; similarly named UK/US professionals excluded.

RNA primary resignation report narrows council cessation to 2018 despite 2019 speaker biography. Obtain exact resignation and treasurer term. ABSF indexed annual update confirms departure by 2019 report but not year boundary.

Recovered source gaps: ABSF PDF full open returned (400) Content length is too large: 13567066; another mirror and RNA 2018 PDF returned Internal Error without code. Indexed primary text and accessible 2018 release used; no access control bypass. Further follow-up requires early-job/employer records, accounting employment histories, Super Butcher appointment/leave and exact political-staff transition.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: Australian Meat News November 2019 resolves substantive full-time status for the chief-of-staff job and subsequent Super Butcher management, and adds a completed butchery apprenticeship. The article confirms an interim overlap after the 2013 family death but gives no exact transition date, weekly hours or leave; no accounting employer names were found.

Follow-up2026-10-04: a primary college biography links the senator to her public professional profile, resolving UQ attendance years and month-level Beef Australia/RNA board terms. UQ2015 BEL philanthropy report p28 lists a Susan McDonald with BCom92/BEcon93, but identity is not independently established and direct PDF open was inaccessible; retain as a lead rather than separate degree-award facts. Accountant-employer and staff/Super Butcher transition searches did not resolve employment dates, hours or leave. No additional full-time duration calculated.

Follow-up2026-10-05: targeted accounting-employer, Brisbane firm and chief-of-staff cessation searches in both indexes yielded existing biographies and overseas namesakes, including Scottish accountants, Irish accounting personnel and a US snack-company CFO; none is independently linked to this senator. Allfrige supplier testimonial (https://allfrigesolutions.com/about-us/) names her as Super Butcher managing director but is undated, adds no commencement/cessation or hours, and does not make Allfrige her employer. Expo and school profiles repeat previously recorded chronology; recent shadow-ministry resignation is not the 2014/15 ministerial-staff boundary. No new employer-specific period or leave evidence established. Preserve existing full-time evidence without a duration; future follow-up needs original accounting personnel records and Super Butcher appointment/transition evidence rather than generic biography repetition.
